name: The Fishing Derby
description: Anglers at the lake-country derby each landed a different fish from a different pond on a different lure. Work out who caught what, and where.
clues: Esther goes with at least one of Catfish or Grayreach.
Esther, Catfish, and Mossbank belong to different catches.
Bluegill goes with exactly one of Cody, Royce, or Willowmere.
Bluegill goes with neither Cody nor Willowmere.
